description: CUDA kernel CPU reference implementation task. Implement Python equivalents of the provided CUDA kernels, matching their exact numerical behavior.

kernels.name: fdtd_3d
kernels.description: 3D finite-difference time-domain stencil computation on a padded volumetric grid

stencil.description: Stencil coefficients [center, radius_1, radius_2, radius_3, radius_4]

volume.description: Output volume. Only the inner DIM^3 region is computed; padding remains zero.

kernels.notes: The kernel applies a 3D star stencil to the inner volume. The output is zero-initialized and only the inner region [RADIUS:RADIUS+DIM] along each axis is written. The CUDA kernel uses a z-slice sweeping algorithm with register-based front/back buffers and shared memory tiling, but the underlying computation is a weighted sum of axis-aligned neighbors.

kernels.name: black_scholes
kernels.description: European option pricing using the Black-Scholes model with polynomial CND approximation
kernels.notes: Uses a polynomial approximation (Abramowitz & Stegun 26.2.17) for the cumulative normal distribution, not standard library CDF. The CUDA kernel uses float2 vectorization for ILP, but this does not affect the computation. The __fdividef(1.0, rsqrtf(T)) intrinsic computes sqrt(T).
